options.name: Sewer repair
options.summary:
this is to repair the sewer under ground, under the deck. 
The property owner will be responsible for having the deck removed and reinstalled. The deck will need to be removed from the building to the start of the stairs. After the deck is removed, but prior to repair date the technician will need to return to mark the area for the PA 1 call.  
The day of repair, the technician will arrive with with a crew and will begin by removing the blacktop under the deck.  The technician will then begin digging down to locate the piping underground. After locating the piping the technician will remove the bad section of pipe and will install a new section of PVC. The technician will also install a new clean out and riser pipe in that location. The technician will bed the piping in stone. The technician will then use the dirt that was removed to backfill the trench. The technician will then tamp the ground as it is backfilled to help prevent settling.  The technician will leave the ground at a finish grade. 
 
After the work is completed the property owner can have the deck rebuilt it will be requested that there be a way to gain access to the clean out in some way.

options.name: Sewer spot repair
options.summary:
this is to replace a section of the underground piping from the clean out about 35’ toward the house. This is a 4” PVC drain line that has a section of cast iron piping in it. The cast iron piping is broken and has tree roots entered in the line.  The homeowner would need to remove the tree prior to us completing the work. 

The technician will first dig down locating the piping and then the old piping will be removed.  Stone will then be added and the new piping will be installed. The dirt that was removed from the trench will then be placed back and tamping will be performed to help prevent settling. The ground will be left at a rough grade and the homeowner will be responsible for any landscaping. 

**just to recap the large tree at the corner of the home would need to be removed prior to any repair being completed**

options.name: Sewer replacement from the house to the trap
options.summary:
This is to replace the sewer main from the house to the trap. The current piping is cast iron and the new piping would be shd 35 pvc piping. The technician will be replacing about 40’ of piping and the depth is 8’ deep. The technician would remove the ground covering plants in the mulched in area.  

The technician will first mark the area to be dug and the place the PA1 call for safe digging. The technician would then dig down exposing the piping and would make a clean cut to tie onto and then remove the old selections of cast iron piping. The technician would the place stone on the bottom of the trench and install the piping.  The technician would install a new trap at the house and then install a clean out where the current trap is. The technician would then test for proper pitch and test the sewer. The technician will also have a third party inspection completed and after passing would begin by placing stone on the top side of the pipe. The technician would then begin to back fill the trench using the soil that was removed. The technician will tamp the ground as filling to help prevent any settling and will leave the ground at a rough finish. 

The homeowner would be responsible for any landscaping.

jobs.jobType: Sewer Camera Video Inspection - Svc Request

visits.jobType: Sewer Camera Video Inspection - Svc Request
visits.writeUp:
Reevaluate the sewer solution 
During the original visit it was determined that the main sewer piping under ground had channel rot and also had multiple bellies in the line. To further explain this channel rot is when the base of the piping has rotted away due to the cast iron becoming brittle and thin. A belly in the sewer line is when the pipe has dropped elevation from the original installation point.  When cast iron piping does this, the joints will break and the piping is no longer sealed which will allow the sewage to escape into the ground. If the sewer line is not repaired any trees in the area will have its roots growing into the sewer main. 
The technician has provided a new solution for the homeowner and is waiting approval.

options.name: Sewer replacement
options.summary:
This is to replace the main sewer from the curb to the house on the exterior of the home and from the exterior wall in the basement to the sewer stack above ground. The technician will abandon the piping under the concrete and will eliminate the floor drain and the washer drain coming from the floor.  The technician will tie onto the excising piping where each fixture meets the sewer stack.  The old piping that was in the floor will be cut flush to the floor and will be filled with concrete. On the outside of the home the technician will remove two bushes in front of the electrical meter and will install the sewer trap in that location.  The technician will install another clean out by the street per code.  

The technician will first dig down to gain access to the piping and will remove the old piping from the house to the street.  Once the old piping is removed the technician will then place stone under the piping and trap and will check for proper operation.  The sewer repair will also be inspected by a third party and after it is approved the technician will place stone over top of the piping to completely surround the pipe. The technician will then backfill the trench using the dirt that was removed and tamping as it is being installed. The technician will leave the ground at a rough grade finish and will remove any dirt and the bushes that were removed.  The homeowner will be responsible to completely surround the landscaping.
